description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReportToAccessStrategy' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Maintenance AccessStrategy plugin. The class manages access rights for employees to reports based on their subordinate or supervisor relationships.

classes.name: ReportToAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class that extends AccessStrategy to determine access rights for employees based on their supervisor or subordinate relationships.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Returns access data for a given employee number, including subordinate and supervisor relationships.
